judge.method: self-judged visual inspection of the Chrome render; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a scene set on top of a solid-looking cloudscape that serves as the ground.
requirements.note: Layered, opaque clouds form the scene's ground.

requirements.text: Include a hot air balloon with a large envelope featuring vertical red and white stripes and a brown wicker basket.
requirements.note: The envelope stripes are red and yellow rather than red and white.

requirements.text: The balloon's basket must be resting firmly on the surface of a large, flat-topped cloud.
requirements.note: The basket visibly hangs above the cloud surface.

requirements.text: Show ropes connecting the balloon's envelope to the basket.
requirements.note: Two dark ropes visibly connect the envelope and basket.

requirements.text: Include four human figures styled as a family: two adults and two children.
requirements.note: Four figures are visible, but two adults and two children are not clearly established.

requirements.text: Position one adult figure holding a corner of a red and white checkered picnic blanket, while one child figure holds the opposite corner, as if they are spreading it out together on the cloud.
requirements.note: The blanket is yellow and no adult-child pair visibly holds opposite corners.

requirements.text: Place an open picnic basket on a corner of the blanket that is already spread out.
requirements.note: No clearly open picnic basket is visible on a blanket corner.

requirements.text: A thermos, a bunch of grapes, and a sandwich must be visible emerging from the open picnic basket.
requirements.note: No open basket visibly contains the required thermos, grapes, and sandwich.

requirements.text: Position the second adult and second child near the landed hot air balloon, with the adult pointing up at the balloon's envelope.
requirements.note: No adult-child pair is positioned near the balloon or visibly pointing at it.

requirements.text: The background must be a clear blue sky containing a bright yellow sun and two small, distant clouds.
requirements.note: A blue sky includes a yellow sun and two small distant clouds.
